title: The Church
definition: The Church is the redeemed people of God, the body of Christ, gathered under His lordship and sent on His mission.
summary: The Church is God's redeemed people, gathered under Christ as one spiritual family and mission.
christFocus: Jesus is the head of the Church, the Savior who builds, loves, shepherds, and sends His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Church is not merely a building, event, organization, or religious service. Scripture presents the Church as the people redeemed by Christ, united to Him, and joined together as His body.

The Church belongs to Jesus. He builds it, rules it, nourishes it, corrects it, and sends it into the world. Believers are not saved into isolation but into a family and body where they worship, learn, serve, and grow.

The Church displays God's wisdom and grace as diverse believers are united in Christ. It is called to sound doctrine, fellowship, prayer, worship, discipleship, love, holiness, mission, and care for the weak.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people treat church as optional or merely personal preference. This doctrine matters because believers need the body of Christ, and the world needs to see a people shaped by the Gospel.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Commit to the life of the Church with humility and love. Gather, serve, learn, forgive, pray, worship, and participate in the mission Christ has given His people.
